look: Amberhide Matriarch, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Amberhides family: great herd mother with a ridge of amber crystal down her back and branching amber horns. Family anatomy: stocky horned grazing beasts like aurochs with amber plates growing through their hide. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are honey amber. A grapefruit-sized GKOM core orb, near-black with a liquid shimmer, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, vivid sweeping stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
